payload.core_mechanism_summary: Kadane's algorithm (maximum subarray sum) applied to two alternating-sign sequences derived from absolute differences of adjacent elements, each representing intervals starting at even or odd indices.
payload.rationale: Solution reduces problem to finding max subarray sum on transformed array: for each start parity, run Kadane's algorithm. It uses 1D DP state (max ending here). No 2D state or tree/interval DP.
